parties:
Abul Kashem Shikder @ Kashem Ali Shikder ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Fazlul Haque Shikder and ors ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff filed the suit contending, in short, inter alia that, the suit land bearing plot Nos. 1006, 1007, 1008 and 1009 of Khatian No. 1 of Mouza Purba Kandi under P.S: Damudya, District Faridpur was the khas land of the Government, that the plaintiff and the defendant No. 1 are cousins, that the defendant-petitioner took settlement of the entire land of the aforesaid four plots including the suit plots from the Government for their mutual interest at a salami of Tk. 1068/- in Settlement Case No. XIII-M523/66-67 in equal share on payment of equal consideration money. This is alleged that settlement was cancelled under Misc. Case No. XIII-B-25/71-72 and defendant No. 1 petitioner filed a review case being Review Case No. XIII -B-70/73-74 and A.D.0 (Rev.), Faridpur upheld the settlement for 1.13 acres of land of Plot Nos. 1006 and 1007 in their favours and cancelled the settlement of the land of Plot Nos. 1008 and 1009. The plaintiff claimed that he shared the costs of the litigations and proceedings in equal share, that the plaintiff has been possessing the entire .37 decimals of land of Plot No. 1006 and 7½ decimals of Plot No. 1007, out of total .89 decimals of land of these two plots, by metes and bound and raising the land above the flood level, planting trees and by raising houses and have been living there for about 30 years. The plaintiff further alleged that he came to know on 31.1.1401 B.S. that, the defendant opposite party No.1 took the suit land along with other land in his own name only and mutated the same in his name. The plaintiff further contends that he filed Misc. Case No. XIII-B-7/93-94 on 31.5.94 against the said mutation of defendant No. 1 which was rejected and he preferred Case No. XIII/94 to the A.D.C. (Rev.) against the same order and the defendant-opposite party no.1 having threatened the plaintiff with dispossession from the land on 3.4.95, the plaintiff has filed this suit claiming title by adverse possession and prayed for confirmation of possession and permanent injunction.
